title: Review shared admission durability-fault classification for transient non-ordinary retries
outcome: Review shared admission durability-fault classification for transient non-ordinary retries
acceptance: Confirm and document how classified admission fence faults map to retryability for queued Bind, retained Evaluate and restart checkpoint callers, using deterministic fault injection.
Preserve strict ordinary fallback on actual local write failures while testing the intended handling of transient WriteFailed and deadline faults for non-ordinary recovery.
Focused tests and the full gate pass, and independent reviews have no unresolved in-scope Medium or higher.
